entries.title: ConfigMap hot reload lost during rollout
entries.symptom: config reverts after kubectl rollout restart
entries.fix: add checksum annotation on Pod template

entries.title: Prefer pnpm over npm in monorepos
entries.symptom: npm install creates inconsistent lockfiles across packages
entries.fix: use pnpm workspace and pnpm-lock.yaml

entries.title: SQLite FTS5 trigram for CJK search
entries.symptom: Chinese queries return zero hits with unicode61 tokenizer
entries.fix: enable trigram tokenizer on FTS5 virtual table

entries.title: SQLite busy timeout under concurrent readers
entries.symptom: database is locked errors from MCP child processes
entries.fix: single writer daemon with loopback HTTP proxy

entries.title: Browser CORS preflight fails on custom headers
entries.symptom: OPTIONS 404 before POST reaches handler
entries.fix: register OPTIONS route or middleware for preflight

entries.title: gRPC deadline smaller than retry budget
entries.symptom: client cancels while server still retrying
entries.fix: set deadline above max retry backoff sum

entries.title: Redis KEYS blocks production
entries.symptom: latency spikes when ops run KEYS *
entries.fix: use SCAN cursor iteration instead of KEYS

entries.title: Docker layer cache busted by apt update
entries.symptom: every rebuild redownloads packages
entries.fix: pin package lists and order COPY of lockfiles first

entries.title: force-push to main destroys review history
entries.symptom: PR commits disappear after rebase push
entries.fix: protect main; use --force-with-lease on feature branches only

entries.title: JWT in localStorage XSS theft
entries.symptom: session stolen via injected script
entries.fix: httpOnly secure cookies; short-lived access tokens

entries.title: liveness probe kills slow starters
entries.symptom: Pod CrashLoopBackOff during cold start
entries.fix: raise initialDelaySeconds; use startupProbe
entries.applies_when: Kubernetes probes on JVM or large apps

entries.title: Postgres sequential scan on missing index
entries.symptom: query planner chooses seq scan on large table
entries.fix: create btree index matching WHERE/JOIN columns

entries.title: Go context cancelled after HTTP handler return
entries.symptom: background work fails with context canceled
entries.fix: detach with context.WithoutCancel or pass request-scoped clone carefully
entries.applies_when: async work spawned from net/http handlers

entries.title: TLS handshake failure missing intermediate
entries.symptom: clients reject certificate chain
entries.fix: serve full chain including intermediates

entries.title: NFS lock hangs SQLite
entries.symptom: SQLite hangs or corrupts on network filesystem
entries.fix: keep SQLite on local disk; never NFS/SMB

entries.title: OAuth state parameter CSRF
entries.symptom: login completes for attacker-controlled account
entries.fix: bind state to session cookie and verify on callback

entries.title: CSS specificity war from utility classes
entries.symptom: styles unexpectedly overridden in production build
entries.fix: reduce !important; control cascade order in bundler

entries.title: Kafka consumer lag from stop-the-world GC
entries.symptom: consumer group lag spikes during GC pauses
entries.fix: tune heap; use cooperative sticky assignor; increase max.poll.interval

entries.title: TOCTOU file replace race
entries.symptom: config file half-written when reader opens it
entries.fix: write temp then atomic rename into place

entries.title: SQL NULL not equal in WHERE
entries.symptom: rows with NULL column missing from equality filter
entries.fix: use IS NULL / IS NOT DISTINCT FROM

entries.title: 中文分词检索遗漏同义词
entries.symptom: 搜索「配置」找不到「ConfigMap」相关经验
entries.fix: 写入双语标题与症状字段；检索用 trigram

entries.title: MCP project_id seed miss hides experiences
entries.symptom: CLI search finds lesson but MCP mem_search pack is empty for same DSN because project_id seed miss
entries.fix: record under cwd-resolved project or use global scope
entries.applies_when: shared local DSN across CLI seed and MCP

entries.title: go embed migrations cannot leave module root
entries.symptom: go: embed pattern ../db refers outside package when embedding migrations
entries.fix: put embed.go next to migration SQL or use a package under db/

entries.title: ULID lexicographic sort equals time order
entries.symptom: need sortable public ids without exposing integer PK
entries.fix: use ULID for uid fields; keep internal bigint id

entries.title: flake tests from shared clock
entries.symptom: time.Now assertions fail near midnight UTC
entries.fix: inject clock interface in tests
entries.applies_when: unit tests depending on wall clock
